'''Mako Ghast''' was a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] who lived on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You've done a great service for us all today. It will be some time before any of Nym's enemies crawl out from under their rocks.|Mako Ghast, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:PtF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Purge the Facility|Lok}}</ref>}}
[[File:Lok_Revenants_leaders_2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Mako Ghast with the other leaders of the Lok Revenants.]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Mako Ghast was a member of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] and a lieutenant of their leader [[Nym/Legends|Nym]]. He used to work in [[Nym's Base|Nym's palace]], in the city known as [[Nym's Stronghold]].<ref name="SWG:KtBT" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Ghast was involved in most major operations of the Lok Revenants.<ref name="SWG:KtBT" /><ref name="SWG:MtM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Mine the Miners|Lok}}</ref><ref name="SWG:PtF" /> That year, the Lok Revenants assaulted the [[Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout|hideout]] of their enemies, the [[Sulfur Lake Pirates]], to retrieve the valuable [[memory module]] of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="SWG:RtDD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Retrieve the Droid Disk|Lok}}</ref> Mako Ghast tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] involved in this mission to kill a dangerous [[Gurk|creature]] known as the [[Bridge Troll]] that guarded the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] hideout.<ref name="SWG:KtBT" /> The same year, the Lok Revenants raided an [[Imperial Mine (Lok)|Imperial mine]] where the release of an unknown toxic gas had made the [[Mining/Legends|miners]] become completely crazy and very hostile.<ref name="SWG:RtMF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Retrieve the Mine Filter|Lok}}</ref> Ghast requested the spacer to eliminate two miners, [[Raynar Cath]] and [[Wes Riggers]], who were notorious opponents of Nym.<ref name="SWG:MtM" /> Later, the Revenants attacked an [[Imperial Research Facility (Lok)|Imperial research facility]] on Lok to steal experimental weapons developed and produced there.<ref name="SWG:RtrdaI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Retrieve the research data and IMGGCUs|Lok}}</ref> This time, Mako Ghast asked the spacer to kill four of the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] who defended the facility, [[Kendo Ryzak]], [[Platt Pareja]], [[Goll Bardok]], [[Jeran Tarven]], because they had meddled in the affairs of Nym.<ref name="SWG:PtF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mako Ghast was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:KtBT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Mako Ghast was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:KtBT" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16]]," on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>
